## size-both.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: size-both.sh <worktree> <label>. Size table with the publication's rename
# step, and again with the step removed from tsdown.config.ts (restored after).
set -euo pipefail
wt=$1; label=$2; out=$(dirname "$0")/size
mkdir -p "$out"
cd "$wt/packages/drag"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$out/$label.rev"
npx just size > "$out/$label-renamed.txt" 2>&1 || true
cp tsdown.config.ts /tmp/claude-1000/-workspaces-material-x/349ded77-beb5-4899-8d18-77db6fe793d2/scratchpad/tsdown.config.$label.bak
sed -i 's/plugins: \[...constructLibraryTsdownPlugins(), renameProperties(names)\],/plugins: [...constructLibraryTsdownPlugins()],/' tsdown.config.ts
grep -q 'plugins: \[...constructLibraryTsdownPlugins()\],' tsdown.config.ts
npx just size > "$out/$label-plain.txt" 2>&1 || true
cp /tmp/claude-1000/-workspaces-material-x/349ded77-beb5-4899-8d18-77db6fe793d2/scratchpad/tsdown.config.$label.bak tsdown.config.ts
git diff --quiet -- tsdown.config.ts

## delta.ts
// Usage: node delta.ts <base.txt> <variant.txt>: per-row min/gz/br deltas.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const read = (f: string) => new Map(readFileSync(f, 'utf8').split('\n').map((l) => /^(.+?)\s+(\d+) min\s+(\d+) gz\s+(\d+) br/.exec(l)).filter(Boolean).map((m) => [m![1]!.trim(), [+m![2]!, +m![3]!, +m![4]!]] as const));
const [a, b] = [read(process.argv[2]!), read(process.argv[3]!)];
for (const [k, v] of a) { const w = b.get(k)!; console.log(`${k.padEnd(30)} ${w.join(' / ').padEnd(22)} ${w.map((x, i) => x - v[i]!).map((d) => (d > 0 ? '+' : '') + d).join(' / ')}`); }
